book.name: 2 Timoti
book.title: Ŋwa wù kiŋgane kifɛɛ wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ Timoti le

content: No taŋlo Timoti jûu yi fiɛɛ fì Nyo le
Timoti mwa yaŋ, ndoo ntu fɛ wo le, wo lɛ̂me gɛh wo tɛɛme bii fitele fì joŋe fì Kletu Jiso dunyɛ fɛ bamii ba taashɛ bɛ wu le.
Wo jôde fiɛɛ fì wo to wo yuge njɛme a bamii fwe wesee wo lêese chiaaŋ yi bamii ba chaaŋ le bo nyu bo kojɛ ki taŋlo bo yɛ̂yi bamii bamu yu.
Wo jôde tɛ wo ŋgɛ njɛ muh jɛŋ wù kooji wu Kletu Jiso.
Sege muh wu jɛŋ le yi lɛme che le gɛ wu ka leese kikwɛɛ fɛ mwɛɛ mu bamii ba le gɛ bamii ba jɛŋ le gɛ, nje fiɛɛ fì wu jiiŋe yi fi le, le ki wù gêe fiɛɛ fì chiji kikwɛɛ ke goone.
Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no gɛ muh wù lege kinlegɛ taŋlo wu legɛ wu so fiɛɛ, njɛ wu lege wu bii banchi ba kinlegɛ le sɛŋ gɛ.
Muh wu mwɛ wù lɛne tɛ chuule le wu kɛ̂me ki wu yâ wu môŋ fiɛɛ antɛnɛɛ a mwɛɛ mù wu gɛ̀ bonɛ.
Wo kwâji kune mwɛɛ mù njɛme munɛ Tada lé wu gê wo kɛ̂ɛ mu munchii.
Wo kwâji kune Jiso Kletu wù gɛ̀ bu yi kwe le. Wu gɛ̀ bee muh wu a kfuu chi Nfoŋ Dabi le. Le fi fì nfeeji a saaka waŋ wù joŋe le.
Le nje saaka wù joŋe wunɛ wù n'yɛne ŋgɛ yu, mɛ nyume yi bancha le njɛ muh wù ŋgode nchi. Geenɛ, mo no nle yi bancha le noo, gɛ jɛ yi Nyo nyume yi bancha le gɛ.
No fi le noo, mɛ mo ntu ŋkaane shɛ́ŋ yi fiɛɛ le fichii nje bamii ba Nyo le wu cha, wu lɛ bo tɛ ge bo kɛ̂mɛ mbvusɛ fede yi Kletu Jiso le bɛ bvukugɛ bvù kage gɛ.
Njɛmɛ wunɛ le nchiɛɛŋ, wù le lɛ:

content.text: Nɛ besabɛŋ le be taashɛ be kwe besa wu,
besabɛŋ tô be sâge bvunfoŋ besa wu.
wu to wu faŋ tɛ besabɛŋ.
Nɛ besabɛŋ le njɛ bee lɛme be tɛɛme sɛŋ,
wu mɛ gɛh wu lɛme wu tɛɛme,
nje gɛ taŋlo wu faŋ kikwɛɛ ke gɛ.

content: Muh wu lɛme wù Nyo le wu bɛɛŋ
Wo ntâne bo bɛ mwɛɛ munɛ, wo ka wo jɛme a Nyo fwe lɛ bo lû bɛ kintɛɛnyɛ ki jɛ́. Gɛ mu fii muh gɛ. Mu chɛŋe gɛh lo bɛ bamii ba yege mu le.

Wo mône chuule ki wo dûunyi kikwɛɛ kuŋ a Nyo jii njɛ muh wù Nyo yɛne lɛ le wù kooji. Wo nyûme muh wu lɛme wù kɛme gɛ fiɛɛ fì bvuya kôode wu yi fi le gɛ, bɛ wu jiji kinchiɛɛŋ ki jɛ yi Nyo le a je yì kooji le.
Wo wɛ̂ɛne lo bɛ banjɛmɛ ba kɛme gɛ fiɛɛ ki bo ge bɛ Nyo gɛ, nje banjɛmɛ bayu le bo ge bamii chêe nyume kinche kì Nyo goone gɛ bo gɛɛne yu fwe.
Ban'yɛyɛ baboo bayu jade bo nyume njɛ nfu wù jii ye yi muh wu yaade wu gɛɛne. Ŋgoo yi bamii ba yɛyi n'yɛyɛ wuyu wunɛ le Amenayu bɛ Filitu.
Bo le bo chinɛ wa je yì nchiɛɛŋ le no bo lɛme lɛ mbu wu yi kwe le, le wu jo wa kijusɛ. Bo doo bo gee noo, bo chɛŋe bɛ mbɛmɛ wu bamii bamu.

Geenɛ, kichi kì lese Nyo le ki tɛɛme, ki lɛme gɛh fo. Kichi kinɛ Nyo le wu saŋ njiŋɛ yu we lɛ, “Tada kee bamii ba le be”, bɛ lɛ, “Muh wuchii wù bɛɛne jee chi Tada, wu kɛme ki wu chînɛ gee chì befe le.”

Mwɛɛ mu yeh yi muh wù baaŋ le gɛ to nyume gɛh shú bɛ ŋkáa mo muŋkoo mù ba kɛnyi bɛ kichwa ki bige kì yɛɛde kɛnɛ kì baaŋ gɛ. Mumu to mu nyume tɛ mù ba kɛnyi bɛ bite mo mù ba kɛnyi bɛ nshɛŋ yì chimɛ. Mwɛɛ munɛ mumu to mu nyume mù kɛme lɛme chì kuge, mumu nyume mù kɛme gɛh lo lɛme chì nchɛ.

Noo, muh nɛ le wu bvusɛ chiaaŋ ye fɛ mwɛɛ mù achiji le, tu wu le wa njɛ fiɛɛ fi yeh fì taŋlo ba jo ba gee lɛme chì kuge yu. Wu le muh wù Nyo le wu ge lɛ wu nyume muh we. Wu le wa muh wù chiɛɛne lo chiji kikwɛɛ ke lɛ wu jôde wu gêe lɛme che chì joŋe mo chì la yu.

Noo, wo lêgɛ lo fiuŋ mwɛɛ mù fɛde ye yufe kiŋghaŋ. Wo mône fiuŋ ki wo chêe kinche nyume kì chaaŋ bɛ ki wo kɛ̂me mbɛmɛ mo kiŋkoŋɛ bɛ kinche kì nyiɛgee. Wo gêe noo gɛh no bamii ba tɛŋe tɛ jee chi Tada bɛ muntele muboo mu yuude gee.
Keefɛ wo kɛ̂me lo fiɛɛ ki wo gê bɛ bambejɛ ba kiyuŋ bɛ ba achiji gɛ, nje bo to bo too gɛh nyu bɛ waa.
Gɛ muh wù lɛme wu Tada kɛme ki wu wâade bɛ bamii gɛ. Wu kɛme ki wu kɛ̂me gɛh nyu fitele fì joŋe fɛ muh le wuchii, wu nyume muh wù kee ki wu yɛ̂yi bamii, wu kee tɛ ki wu kâane shɛ́ŋ bɛ bamii.
Wu to wu naji fiɛɛ nyiɛgee bɛ bamii ba tɛɛnyi bɛ wu. Wu to wu naji noo bɛ ŋkwajɛ lɛ taŋlo Nyo fî bo, bo kûsɛ muntele muboo bo kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì nchiɛɛŋ,
bo mo bo tɛ̂ɛŋ bvufee bvuboo jiŋ, bo lêgɛ bo bû a kintase ki debele kì wu le wu koo bo yo lɛ bo gêe gɛh nyume fiɛɛ fì wu koŋe.
